svg.text: Digital dice: 555 clock + 74LS161 counter (1 to 6) + 74LS48 decoder + 7-segment display
Hold SW1 to roll (555 runs only while pressed). Release to freeze the count. NAND of QB and QC reloads 0001 at 6, so the count loops 1 to 6.
Power supply (9 V battery to regulated 5 V)
Crossing wires without a dot are not connected. Every +5V flag joins the 7805 output; every GND symbol joins battery negative.
Parts: R1 1k, R2 47k, R3 10k, C1 100nF, C2 10nF, C3-C6 100nF decoupling, C7 330nF, C8 100nF, C9 100uF electrolytic.
U4 74LS48: active-high outputs with internal 2k pull-ups drive the common-cathode display directly, so no segment resistors are used (about 1.5 mA per segment).
